unit: Input event at which the fuzzer stopped, log scale
title: How Fast the Fuzzer Caught Each Planted Bug
subtitle: Six mutants of the engine, each fuzzed against the reference matcher, first failure on seed 1

legendLabels.emphasis: Caught only by the periodic state comparison
legendLabels.other: Caught by the per event output diff

rows.label: Trade at taker price
rows.detail: Trades print at the aggressor's limit instead of the resting order's price. First divergence on N 7 S LMT 9982 76

rows.label: LIFO within a level
rows.detail: New orders join the front of their price level's queue. First divergence on N 57 B LMT 10000 75

rows.label: Post-only may lock
rows.detail: A post-only order priced exactly at the opposite touch is allowed to rest. First divergence on N 73 B POST 10004 71

rows.label: FOK off by one
rows.detail: Fill or kill cancels when available quantity exactly equals the order size. First divergence on N 347 S FOK 9982 9

rows.label: Modify up keeps priority
rows.detail: A size increase at the same price keeps its queue position. The output events were identical, so it surfaced only when the priority ordered order lists were compared at event 3000

rows.label: No L2 on amend
rows.detail: An in place size reduction publishes no book update. First divergence on M 1908 9989 9

caption: Every mutant was caught within 3,487 events of a 200,000 event run. The one realistic priority bug produced no wrong output at the moment it happened and was found by comparing full book state, checked every 100 events in this run.
